content: {"outdated": false, "reason": "The earlier version (2023-09-26) does not address early withdrawal (Vorbezug) of old-age benefits; it only sets standard retirement ages (65 for men, 62 for women) and allows pension fund regulations to link entitlement to the end of gainful employment. The current question asks for the minimum age for early withdrawal (63 years) under Art. 13 para. 2 BVG, a provision not present in the earlier version."}
